preview: Barbados Tridents face Jamaica Kingsmen in CPL 2026 Match 34 at Kensington Oval. The match is scheduled for Sat 12 Sep at 8pm local time.
preview_detail: Barbados return to the Tridents identity and national colours in 2026, with Gudakesh Motie, Sherfane Rutherford and Brandon King among the senior Caribbean core. The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
